subject: Go/No-Go: runtime-1.22 (hardware profile pack defaults + rollout gates) — sign-off by 2pm PT

body:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwoodinference.com>, Omar El-Sayed <omar.elsayed@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 3, 2026 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Go/No-Go: runtime-1.22 (hardware profile pack defaults + rollout gates) — sign-off by 2pm PT

All — we’re on the runtime-1.22 train and need a go/no-go today for enabling the profile pack defaults in Hosted (Dedicated stays opt-in).

Target: cut release candidate EOD today; start Hosted canary Wed AM.

Please reply with GO or NO-GO by 2pm PT, and call out any blocking gaps.

Go/No-Go checklist (v3 attached):

1) Code + flags
- [ ] Profile pack loader + schema validation landed and green in CI
- [ ] Selection logic deterministic by SKU + driver/CUDA compatibility checks
- [ ] Kill-switch confirmed (disable profile pack + revert to legacy defaults) w/ no restart requirement in Hosted
- [ ] /health + debug endpoints include profile_id + profile_version for on-call

2) Perf gating
- [ ] benchmark-lab matrix pass: H100 + L40S against thresholds (p50/p95/p99 + tps + GPU util + OOM)
- [ ] perf-canary checks wired: alert on >3% p95 regression or >8% p99 regression at constant workload
- [ ] Known regression from last week mitigated (batching default) — confirm final defaults

3) Observability
- [ ] Metrics tagged by profile_id + sku (cardinality reviewed)
- [ ] Dashboards: “Runtime Profiles” overview + kernel fallback counters + scheduler_queue_ms panels
- [ ] Alerts: kernel fallback rate + scheduler queue time + OOM/fragmentation signals

4) Docs readiness
- [ ] Confluence overview + schema/selection rules + expected behavior (H100/L40S/B200 preview)
- [ ] Rollout runbook + rollback steps (who can trigger, audit trail)
- [ ] Release note draft for runtime-1.22 includes “what changed / how to pin”

5) Rollout plan
Hosted:
- Canary cohort: 5% traffic, 2 regions, model mix (top 3 chat + embeddings)
- Gates: rollback if p99 +8% sustained 30m OR error rate +0.2% absolute OR OOM spike

Dedicated:
- Opt-in only this train; pinning supported; customer messaging prepared (Lauren)

Private:
- No default change; Helm values documented; warn on unsupported driver/CUDA combos

Attachments:
- runtime-1.22-go-no-go-checklist-v3.pdf
- runtime-1.22-release-plan-v2.docx

Thanks,
Connor
Release Engineering | Redwood Inference

GO from Runtime, contingent on confirming we’re shipping with the post-24988 batching defaults.

Notes:
- Kernel selection v3 on H100 is behind the profile (not a global flip) and we’ve got fallbacks + telemetry.
- B200 compatibility gate must remain “hard fail unless explicitly pinned profile_version” (no auto-defaults). Please ensure release notes call this out for early access nodes.

Mateo

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 3, 2026 at 9:54 AM PT
Subject: Re: Go/No-Go: runtime-1.22 (hardware profile pack defaults + rollout gates) — sign-off by 2pm PT

Infra: GO for Hosted canary.

Conditions / caveats to capture explicitly:
- Fleet is still heterogeneous on H100 (SXM vs PCIe + minor driver skew by region). Selection logic must log detected SKU + driver/CUDA and reject unsupported combos rather than “best guess.”
- For L40S, we need conservative headroom defaults. We’ve seen intermittent OOM under burst traffic; please keep the concurrency cap in place for this train.

Also: please confirm the canary cohort includes at least one of the noisier regions (us-east is fine) — otherwise we won’t flush out scheduling tail behavior.

Neha

Subject: Re: Go/No-Go: runtime-1.22 (hardware profile pack defaults + rollout gates) — sign-off by 2pm PT

Observability: GO.

Status:
- Dashboards are in place (Runtime Profiles overview + kernel_choice/fallback + scheduler_queue_ms).
- Alerts staged as ticket-first during canary; paging only if both (a) kernel fallback >5% for 15m AND (b) p95 latency regression >3% vs baseline.
- We’re tagging latency histograms with profile_id + sku; cardinality is within limits given the current set (H100/L40S + limited model family labels).

One ask: on the canary announcement, please include the exact metric names we’ll use for rollback triggers so on-call isn’t hunting.

Allison

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 3, 2026 at 11:08 AM PT
Subject: Re: Go/No-Go: runtime-1.22 (hardware profile pack defaults + rollout gates) — sign-off by 2pm PT

SRE: GO for Hosted canary, with one change to your gate wording.

For rollback we should use:
- p99 latency +8% sustained 15m (not 30m) on the canary cohort, OR
- error rate +0.2% absolute sustained 10m, OR
- OOM events >0 in any single canary cell (we can be strict here)

Reason: last week’s p99 issue moved fast; we don’t want to burn 30m of customer pain if it’s clearly the profile defaults.

Rafael and I confirmed kill-switch semantics:
- Toggle reverts selection to legacy defaults for new requests.
- It does not unload/reload models; that’s OK for immediate mitigation.
- We still want a follow-up to confirm we can force a model reload in a controlled way if we need to revert KV cache knobs (not a blocker for this train).

Sean

What’s done:
- Overview page + schema/selection rules page are complete.
- Expected behavior pages for H100 and L40S have the required tables (latency/throughput buckets + trade-offs + common failure modes).
- B200 preview page is clearly labeled “provisional” and includes the hard compatibility gate and metrics to watch.

What’s pending:

If we need to ship before that doc is merged, I’d still recommend we proceed but include the runbook link in the canary announcement only once updated.

Elliot

Product/Dedicated: GO with Dedicated kept opt-in (as you wrote).

Request for release notes / internal comms:
- Make it explicit that Dedicated customers can pin profile_version (and that Support has a short procedure).
- Make it explicit that we are not changing defaults for Dedicated without customer notification, and that Hosted canary results will inform when we propose a Dedicated default.

Lauren

Thanks all — capturing final decision + deltas.

Decision: GO to cut runtime-1.22 RC today and proceed with Hosted canary Wed AM.

Incorporated changes:
- Rollback triggers updated per SRE (p99 +8% sustained 15m; err +0.2% for 10m; any OOM in canary cell).
- Confirmed shipping with post-PR-24988 batching defaults (the aggressive default is reverted).
- Canary cohort will include us-east + one additional region; include model mix (top 3 chat + embeddings) + at least one “mixed prompt length” route.
- Dedicated remains opt-in; release note includes pin procedure + guardrails.
- B200: hard compatibility gate stays; no auto-defaulting. Release note callout added.

Next steps:
1) I’ll cut RC and send the exact git SHA + the checklist “green” screenshot to this thread.
2) Allison: please share the final metric names + dashboard links for the canary announcement.
3) Elliot/Kira: please confirm runbook page is updated by 1pm PT (if not, send me the diff and I’ll include the gate text in the announcement directly).

Connor

Here are the exact signals for the canary post:

Dashboards:
- Runtime Profiles Overview: (internal) /dashboards/runtime-profiles-overview
- Kernel Fallbacks: (internal) /dashboards/runtime-kernel-fallbacks
- Scheduler Queueing: (internal) /dashboards/runtime-scheduler-queueing

Rollback triggers (canary filter: cohort=rt122_profilepack_canary):
- Latency p99: metric=runtime_request_latency_ms{cohort=...,stage="end_to_end"} compare vs baseline; rollback if +8% sustained 15m
- Error rate: metric=runtime_http_5xx_rate{cohort=...}; rollback if +0.2% absolute sustained 10m
- OOM: metric=runtime_oom_events_total{cohort=...}; rollback if any increment in a canary cell
- Kernel fallback: metric=runtime_kernel_fallback_rate{cohort=...}; ticket if >5% for 15m; page only if also p95 regresses

Also: the new tag keys are profile_id and profile_version; sku is normalized (h100_sxm, h100_pcie, l40s).

Allison
